Directions: Read and study the sources about early immigrants to Louisiana. Then use the four sources and your knowledge of social studies to answer each question that follows.
Title: Source 1: German Settlement in Louisiana
Content: The swampy region west of New Orleans came to be known as the German Coast, because German settlers began to arrive there in the `text(early 1700s)`. They established farms and married early French settlers. Food from those farms fed the people in the struggling settlement of New Orleans. In later `text(decades)`, German settlers married Acadian settlers and helped to create Cajun culture. Historians believe that Germans introduced the accordion to Cajun music.
